head: Samsung Recompose may let Galaxy AI change a photo's angle
dek: Code in One UI 9.5 Beta 1's Photo Editor shows a Galaxy AI tool called Recompose that would let you change a photo's angle and perspective after you've taken it, Android Authority found. Samsung hasn't announced it, and it may not ship.
details: The phone would build a 3D scene with the 153 MB Spatial Core add-on from the Galaxy Store, then Samsung's cloud would draw the final photo; Android Authority expects it to need internet and a Samsung account, like Samsung's other generative edits. One finger changes the perspective, two fingers pan, zoom and rotate, and a slider moves the background closer or farther away. Photos need a short side of at least 500 pixels. It didn't show up on a Galaxy S26 Ultra in testing, and it's unclear which phones will get it.
where: Galaxy phones; found in One UI 9.5 Beta 1 code, not switched on
means: If you have a Galaxy phone, a later Photo Assist update could let you reframe a shot after taking it, but Samsung hasn't said which phones would get it.
todo: Nothing to do yet; it isn't available, even in the beta.
thumb_words: SAMSUNG AI MAY CHANGE PHOTO ANGLES
